items.title: Willie "Old Man" Parker Interview, 1958-11-07
items.q: This fella, you know him too, you heard him. Buddy Bowling. Yes. Oh, he was a blues king.

ctx.x: Did he read? Yeah. He read all good. Good musicians. This fella, you know him too, you heard him. Buddy Bowling. Yes. Oh, he was a blues king. Yes. He brought them blues out. Old Buddy Bowling. Old Buddy Bowling. Buddy Bowling. I don't know why he comes. Somewhere out of the country. What did he play like? Did he play... Buddy Bowling. He played lots of blues, you say?
Oh, he played a blues. What? Mm-hm.
